name: squeeze_floor_none_is_legacy_passthrough
description: AC-1 back-compat: squeeze_floor=None (the default) applies NO clamp -- byte-identical to the legacy 6-arg squeezed value. Pins that the DEFAULT keeps every existing caller (incl. the 6-arg docs/research/risk/scripts/i2_compounding_sim.py witness) unchanged.
derivation: pre_squeeze=max(0.30,0.10)=0.30. para_armed -> active=0.30*0.5=0.15. squeeze_floor=None -> no clamp. Output 0.15 (legacy squeezed value, no floor applied).
